event_date_note: Treated as real on the operator's instruction, but the soft evidence points to 2026-10-16. Hingham does not pre-announce dates. In 2026 every release has gone out on the third Friday of the month: Q4 2025 on 2026-01-16 (https://www.nasdaq.com/press-release/hingham-savings-reports-2025-results-2026-01-16), Q1 2026 on 2026-04-17 (https://www.hinghamsavings.com/assets/2026/04/PRESS-RELEASE-Q1-2026.pdf), Q2 2026 on 2026-07-17 (https://www.hinghamsavings.com/assets/2026/07/PRESS-RELEASE-Q2-2026.pdf). Only Q3 2025 used the second Friday (2025-10-10, https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/10/10/3165094/33478/en/hingham-savings-reports-third-quarter-2025-results.html). MarketBeat estimates 2026-10-16 and Earnings Whispers 2026-10-15. No Q3 2026 release was found as of the 13:08 ET seal. This is a cadence inference and not a hard document. If nothing appears at 16:01 ET today, the exit window carries no print and every finding below resolves on the next Friday.
conviction_note: The findings net to -0.1 because they offset: a near-flat equity-securities mark (13F book about +0.5% in Q3) halves GAAP EPS from $11.49 to roughly $5.5, and the Sept 17 Fed hike hurts a wholesale-funded margin, while core EPS should be a record of about $5.1-5.4 once Q2's $1.13m of one-off expenses drop out and a 16.6% short float tilts the reaction to a clean credit table upward. There is no options market, no consensus and no sourced reaction history, so abs_move 4.5 is scaled up from 20-day realised vol for a thin, crowded name; p_up 48 is close to a non-result. Separately, the release date itself is doubtful (third-Friday cadence points to Oct 16).
bar: unsourced. No consensus exists: MarketBeat lists the Q2 2026 estimate as N/A (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-17-hingham-institution-for-savings-stock/) and finviz shows no estimate or coverage (https://finviz.com/quote.ashx?t=HIFS). Sized against Q2 2026 core diluted EPS of $4.82 as a run-rate reference (https://www.hinghamsavings.com/assets/2026/07/PRESS-RELEASE-Q2-2026.pdf), so every finding is capped small. Note that GAAP EPS has no bar either.
positioning_check: finviz snapshot on 2026-10-09 (https://finviz.com/quote.ashx?t=HIFS): short float 16.61%, short ratio 6.82 days, 0.30M shares short on a 1.78M float; settlement date not stated. This is a crowded short, built since Wolfpack Research's February 2026 short report on Washington DC CRE credit, which the bank rebutted (https://www.barchart.com/story/news/452251/recent-reporting-regarding-hingham). There is no options market, so there is no skew. Perf month -5.25%, run_up_20d -6.19%, 12% below the 52-week high. Every negative below is shrunk for squeeze risk.

findings.finding: The marketable equity book barely moved in Q3 2026, so the 'gain on equity securities' line that made Q2 GAAP EPS $11.49 (an $18.95m gain) should be near zero. On the 13F's top eight holdings (~$122m of the $134m 13F book), weighted Q3 price moves net to about +$0.7m: GOOGL -3.7% (357.37 to 344.08, 28% weight), V +4.7%, BRK.B -0.5%, CBNA +9.6%, MA +7.4%, HEI.A -11.5%, PGR -5.1%, SPGI +2.4%. GAAP EPS therefore prints near core, about $5.3-5.7, down roughly 30% from Q3 2025's $7.85 and about half of Q2. The AP/RTT headline will read as an earnings drop.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 GAAP EPS fell ~60% YoY on a $9.9m equity loss while core rose 72%, and the sweep row (unsourced) has the stock -5.96% after it. Q3 2025, with a large gain, was followed by -6.89% (unsourced). After Q2 2026's $18.95m gain the stock drifted lower (stockscan aggregator, approximate). The line has not been rewarded when positive, and its negative may have been sold once.
findings.source_date: 2026-07-21 (13F-HR for Q2 2026); Q3 prices from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/GOOGL (and V, BRK-B, CBNA, MA, HEI-A, PGR, SPGI), closes 2026-06-30 and 2026-09-30
findings.why_not_priced: Anyone with the July 13F and a price screen can compute it, and Hingham's holders do. If they had fully priced a weak GAAP headline, there would be no AP 'EPS down' snapshot risk to sell into. The line still lands on the headline that automated wires print. Mostly priced, which is why it is small.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 10-Q note 5 confirms Alphabet remained the largest equity holding after a partial sale and puts marketable equities at $155.5m (https://www.hinghamsavings.com/assets/2026/08/Form-10-Q-Q22026.pdf). Same holdings source, so it is not independent on the sign.

findings.finding: Core EPS should be a record of about $5.1-5.4 against $4.82 in Q2. Q2 operating expense carried a $928k Fiserv termination fee and a $201k check-fraud loss, about $0.38 per share after tax, and neither recurs. Net interest income rose $1.47m QoQ on a 10bp NIM expansion to 2.14%, as interest-bearing deposit cost fell 5bp and non-interest-bearing deposits grew 15.6% annualised.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Core EPS rose QoQ in Q4 2025 ($4.54), Q1 2026 ($4.79) and Q2 2026 ($4.82), and the stock was weak after at least two of those prints per the sweep row and the stockscan aggregator. Core beats have not been bought.
findings.why_not_priced: With no analyst publishing a number, nobody has written down that Q2 core was understated by the one-offs. If it were priced, the stock would not sit at 1.27x stated book (finviz) and -5% on the month while core ROE trends toward the bank's 'acceptable' level.
findings.independence: Q1 2026 release core $4.79 (https://www.hinghamsavings.com/assets/2026/04/PRESS-RELEASE-Q1-2026.pdf) shows the same trend. Same company, different document.

findings.finding: The Fed raised the funds target 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on 2026-09-17, after a July meeting with three hike dissents. That works against a bank funded by $1.405bn of FHLB advances and $510m of wholesale deposits, whose Q2 NIM gains came from adding lower-rate FHLB advances and repricing deposits down. The Q3 release's cost-of-funds line and the chairman's commentary are where a turn in the margin story would show.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No sourced reaction history. Margin expansion has been the bank's stated driver, and its quotes in the Q2 release lean on it ('sustained expansion in the net interest margin through asset repricing and falling funding costs').
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: KBW Bank Index fell from 181.30 to 169.96 in Q3 (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/%5EBKX) and HIFS is -5.25% on the month. What is not priced is the company's own disclosure of whether liability costs bottomed in Q3. Hingham gives no guidance, so its commentary is the only forward read.
findings.independence: This is a macro-to-company proxy that the company has not confirmed. The funding-mix figures are from the Q2 2026 press release (https://www.hinghamsavings.com/assets/2026/07/PRESS-RELEASE-Q2-2026.pdf).

findings.finding: Hingham scheduled a foreclosure auction for 2026-06-30 on One Lewis Wharf, a Boston North End office building it financed with a $9.65m loan in Feb 2020 against a $13.2m purchase. The loan was not 90+ days past due or nonaccrual at June 30 per the 10-Q, so any foreclosed asset, specific reserve or first charge-off would first appear in Q3. That would feed the Wolfpack credit narrative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Hingham has recorded no charge-offs in H1 2025 or H1 2026. The stock fell ~8% on the February 2026 Wolfpack credit report (secondary source), so credit headlines move it.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q2 release lists NPAs as three real-estate loans and eight DC foreclosed properties and does not mention this Boston office credit, so a holder reading the bank's own documents would not see it. Its outcome (auction result, cure, payoff) is not public anywhere searched. If priced, the Q2 NPL table would have carried it.
findings.independence: The Q2 2026 10-Q past-due table (https://www.hinghamsavings.com/assets/2026/08/Form-10-Q-Q22026.pdf) shows only the $30.6m DC loan 90+ days past due in CRE. That argues the loan may have been current, cured or paid at auction, so the finding is kept small.

findings.finding: 16.6% of float is short (6.8 days to cover) on a $11m-a-day name, built around Wolfpack's February 2026 thesis of hidden DC CRE losses. The Q3 release is the first test since Q2. That release showed NPAs at 0.78%, no charge-offs and foreclosed DC properties being sold without loss, so another clean credit table is a squeeze mechanism.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No sourced history of a squeeze on a print. After the clean-credit Q2 the stock drifted lower rather than squeezing (stockscan, approximate).
findings.why_not_priced: A short float this large means the market holds a credit-loss view the bank's own tables have not yet shown. If the market believed the clean tables, short interest would have fallen after Q2 instead of sitting at 16.6%.
findings.independence: Bank rebuttal of Wolfpack (https://www.barchart.com/story/news/452251/recent-reporting-regarding-hingham); Q2 2026 asset-quality section (https://www.hinghamsavings.com/assets/2026/07/PRESS-RELEASE-Q2-2026.pdf). It shares the credit question with finding 4 but takes the opposite reading of the same unknown, and the two are left offsetting deliberately.

outside_window.finding: If the release follows 2026's third-Friday cadence, it lands on 2026-10-16. In that case every finding above resolves outside a 2026-10-09 to 2026-10-12 window.
California lawsuit over $2.2m of unauthorised wire transfers ($341k recovered); the bank deems a loss possible but not probable and gives no estimate.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree with. The findings net slightly negative, in line with the -6.19% 20-day run-up and the weak bank tape, but a 16.6% short float cuts against any negative, so every negative was shrunk and p_up sits at 48 rather than lower.
lessons_applied: Lesson 2 (one-offs): equity-securities mark sized as one_off, -0.6 to -0.4; a public-stock remeasurement computable from the 13F has no path to the multiple
Lesson 6 (unsourced bar): no consensus exists, so core finding capped +0.6 to +0.5 and print_vs_bar trimmed 8 to 7
Lessons 5 and 7 (macro proxy, crowded short): Fed-hike finding -0.6 to -0.4 and Lewis Wharf -0.3 to -0.2, both shrunk for the 16.6% short float and for being unconfirmed by the company
Lesson 8 (thin coverage) and the core table: abs_move raised 4.0 to 4.5 for a no-coverage, thin, crowded name whose two sweep-cited reactions were ~6-7%
Lesson 3 (own caveats): finding 4's independence argues against it; resolved by keeping it small rather than dropping it, since there is no contradicting document for Q3
